boards.dek: The out-of-timeout play that beat the Clippers in overtime, drawn on the board.

moves.title: The Splash
moves.dek: Steph's jumper, in motion: one motion from the hip, gone on the way up, and he's walking away before it drops.

moves.title: Freight Train
moves.dek: LeBron's drive, in motion: downhill at full speed, through the contact, then the flex.

moves.title: Denied by Wemby
moves.dek: His block, in motion: long strides to erase a lost step, a reach nobody else has, and the ball goes back the other way.

xo.dek: The off-ball screen that frees a shooter, in four steps.
